description: Says which client wrote a Google review, as Contacts > Needs review does: client_id links it (also moving a review linked to the wrong client), client_id null says no client wrote it (unlinking a linked review). A link closes that client's review requests. Find reviews and their ids with read google_reviews. Nothing is sent or posted to Google. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: answer_google_review_match
title: Link or unlink a Google review and a client
